evals.prompt: Crie a suíte de auditoria Jest + React Testing Library + Axe-Core para o componente <SurfaceCard /> validando as 4 variantes de Card (elevated, outlined, subtle, interactive), tokens em 3 camadas (OKLCH), sombras multi-camadas, alinhamento tabular, FSM e anti-XSS.
expected_assertions: Includes AUDIT-A11Y-01 (axe toHaveNoViolations) and AUDIT-A11Y-02 (keyboard focus, tabular-nums, prefers-reduced-motion)

Includes AUDIT-VIS-01 verifying 3-layer semantic tokens (--bg-canvas/--surface-canvas, --bg-surface-1/--surface-card, --text-primary/--ink-primary), 3-level shadows (--shadow-elevation-1..3), Card variants, and zero orphan components
Includes AUDIT-STATE-01 (Loading role=status aria-busy=true -> Idle -> Pressed) and AUDIT-STATE-02 (Error role=alert)
Includes AUDIT-SEC-01 testing and runs audit_tactile_ui.py with weights (0.35, 0.30, 0.20, 0.15)

evals.prompt: Run audit_tactile_ui.py against our React frontend directory to verify WAI-ARIA, zero emojis, Base64 bloat < 50 KB, Real-State FSM, and anti-XSS.
expected_assertions: Verifies readiness_score >= 90.0, s_tokens >= 85.0, and s_fsm >= 85.0 with zero comment-gaming or orphan SurfaceCard penalties

evals.prompt: Measure DOM depth, divsoup ratio, 90-120 zenithal light, and WCAG color pair ratios in our static HTML/CSS stylesheets via ui_ux_frontend_auditor.py.
expected_assertions: Does not trigger frontend-testing-auditor when the user explicitly requests mathematical DOM density and CSS physics metrics via ui_ux_frontend_auditor.py; routes to frontend-ui-ux-auditor

evals.prompt: Organize as pastas do Google Drive e crie uma tabela particionada no BigQuery.
expected_assertions: Does not trigger frontend-testing-auditor for Google Drive organization or BigQuery DDL tasks
